BENEFIT | ANTHEM BLUE PRIORITY (HMO) | ANTHEM BLUE ACCESS (PPO)
---|---|---
Osteotomies of Temporo-mandibular Joint dysfunction (TMJ) | authorized in advance. | authorized in advance.
Oral Surgery | Some surgical procedures will be covered but only under the strict guidelines listed in the plan book. Usually with the PCP* and the Plan authorizing treatment determined to be medically necessary for the health of the patient. It is best to refer to HMP for specifics. | Covered at 90%. Expenses will be covered if for repair to an injury as a result of an accident. For initial repair of an injury to jaw, sound natural teeth, mouth or face which are required as a result of an accident. Initial repair must be within 12 months. | Covered at 70%. Expenses will be covered if for repair to an injury as a result of an accident. For initial repair of an injury to jaw, sound natural teeth, mouth or face which are required as a result of an accident. Initial repair must be within 12 months.
Out-of-area Emergency | $50 copayment (waived if admitted.) ER physician charges covered in full. | $50 copayment (waived if admitted). ER physician charges covered in full. | $50 copayment (waived if admitted). ER physician charges covered in full. Out of area emergencies covered at network level.
Out patient Diagnostic Services | Covered in full. | Covered in full. | Covered at 70%.
Out patient Hemodialysis | Covered in full. | Subject to facility charge. | Covered at 70%.
Out patient Surgery | Covered in full. | $50 copayment | Covered at 70%.
Out patient Treatment of Mental/Nervous Disorders | 50 visits per calendar year. Subject to office visit copayment. | Limited to 50 visits annually. $10 copayment. Approval by Magellan is required. | Limited to 10 visits annually. Covered at 70%.
Physical Therapy and Occupational Therapy | Physical & occupational Outpatient (60 visit limit annually) - $5 copayment. Inpatient - 60 days for physical med & rehab (annual). | Physical & occupational Outpatient (60 visit limit annually) - $10 Copayment. Inpatient - 60 days for physical med & rehab (annual). | Physical & occupational Outpatient (60 visit limit annually) - Covered at 70%. Inpatient (60 days for physical med & rehab (annual).
Pre-admission Testing | Covered in full. | Covered in full. | Covered at 70%.
Private duty nursing | Covered in full. Must be pre-approved. | Covered in full. Must be pre-approved. | Covered at 70%.
Prosthetic Devices/Durable | Covered 80% . Repair or replacement due to growth | Covered 80% . Repair or replacement due to growth | Covered 70% . Repair or replacement due to growth
